title: Action Words: Journey of a Journalist
author: Judi Miller
target_audience: Readers interested in Australian media history
General audience seeking inspiration from real-life stories
core_themes: Personal and professional development in journalism
Challenges and triumphs faced by women in media
The evolution of the news industry in Australia
primary_purpose: To recount Judi Miller’s life and career as a journalist, offering insights into the realities of news reporting, highlighting the changing landscape of media, and inspiring future generations with her experiences and reflections.

structure_format.organization: Chronological, beginning with early influences and spanning decades in journalism, interspersed with thematic reflections
features: Profiles of editors, journalists, and newsrooms
Reflections on journalism’s ethics and societal impact

key_concepts_lessons: Journalism is a demanding but rewarding career shaped by curiosity and resilience.
Integrity and ethical considerations are at the heart of good reporting.
Adapting to industry changes—technology, culture, and public expectations—is essential.
Women can and do excel in traditionally male-dominated newsrooms, despite obstacles.
Every story has the power to inform, connect, and create lasting impact.
notable_features: Firsthand account of the changing landscape of Australian journalism
Insights into newsroom culture and operations
Portraits of significant figures and pivotal stories in Australian media
Focus on the challenges and achievements of female journalists
cultural_historical_context: Published in 2001, the book captures major shifts in Australian journalism from the mid-to-late 20th century, including gender dynamics in newsrooms and the transition to digital media.
reception_impact: Appreciated for its candid, inspiring narrative and historical perspective
Frequently recommended to those entering the media industry
Valued for its nuanced exploration of ethical challenges in journalism
Used as an educational text in communication and journalism studies in Australia
comparable_titles: A Good Life: Newspapering and Other Adventures by Ben Bradlee
